language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hi there! My name is Amy and I come from a family of brave explorers. This is the only place where dinosaurs are still known to roam and I am going out to look for them today!
I hope you can come along and help me with some of the tasks that I may encounter along the way. Right now I am looking for a new species of winged dinosaur similar to the Teradactyl.
We’ve only seen it twice and the last place it was seen was at this point on the map, W 6,8.
Dinosaurs, how exciting! Let's join her on this quest!

I’m noticing there are all kinds of angles on my compass. The center point of an angle is called the vertex and the lines of the angle are called the arms. Can you help me answer some questions about the angles on my compass?

helperSimple.text: Decide if the statements are True or False.

activities.title: Is it true or false?
activities.subtitle: The center point of the compass is the vertex for all of the angles on the compass.

activities.title: Is it true or false?
activities.subtitle: The angle produced between the directions of N and W is a right angle.

activities.title: Is it true or false?
activities.subtitle: The angle produced between E and SE is an acute angle.

activities.title: Is it true or false?
activities.subtitle: The angle produced between the directions of NE and SE is a right angle.

outro.text: Thank you so much for helping me answer these questions.
